ambient_events: The pad's light ring pulses blue.
A windsock on the lift tower snaps round and goes slack.
description: The roof of the garage: a square landing pad marked in white with a blue light ring, set into a turntable the carousel lifts and lowers. A steel terminal on a post at the edge takes your aircraft down and gives you a ticket. The lift is in.
name: Airport Parking Plaza, Roof Pad
